title: Event
description: A BPMN-style event node in a process flow (Core Model §03 Canvas, Phase F). Events model what starts, interrupts, or ends a flow for a reason other than a task completing: a timer firing or a message arriving. kind places it (start / intermediate / end); trigger says what fires it (none / timer / message). Structural only — like a gateway it carries no guardrail; the tasks it routes to do.

id.description: Fully-qualified event id, e.g. CO.3.2.7.e1 — process apqc_code + '.e' + n.

kind.description: Where the event sits: a start event begins the flow, an end event finishes it, an intermediate event fires in between (a catch).

trigger.description: What fires the event: none (a plain start/end), timer (a date/duration), or message (an inbound message).

timer.description: For trigger=timer: an ISO-8601 duration/date or a cron-like expression (e.g. 'P1D', '2026-01-01', '0 9 * * 1'). Free text — surfaced verbatim, not evaluated here.

message_ref.description: For trigger=message: the name of the message that fires this event (e.g. 'payment_received').
